G06:M002.text: Ah, you are that moogle's friend.
G06:M002.reason: Afirmación, no pregunta sobre la amistad.

G06:M003.text: That moogle said he could not stay at the inn and asked me to lend him a house.
G06:M003.reason: No afirma falta de habitaciones; pide una casa prestada.

G06:M004.text: He went ahead and took the key to the empty house!
G06:M004.reason: Restituye casa vacía y acción unilateral.

G06:M010.text: I hear you have been bringing back all sorts of items lately.
G06:M010.reason: Restituye información recibida y tiempo verbal.

G06:M012.text: I see... Something possessed {Camilla's Dad}, and he built a dungeon under the inn.
G06:M012.reason: Posesión y construcción, no rapto ni encargo.

G06:M015.reason: 先生: tratamiento coherente del investigador.

G06:M016.text: Do you remember the four books found when this village was founded?

G06:M018.text: Could you find them for me?

G06:M019.text: Thank you for telling me. This may help us learn something.
G06:M019.reason: Agradece información; no elogia educación ni interroga.

G06:M026.text: Good to see you. We found two books!
G06:M026.reason: Saludo y hallazgo; no mérito atribuido al visitante.

G06:M027.text: {Regla} will tell you about the other book.

G06:M029.text: I will look for the other two books as well.

G06:M030.text: Hello. We found two books! The Professor has one of them.
G06:M030.reason: Dos libros, no segundo libro; tratamiento coherente.

G06:M031.reason: 興味深い: interesante, no peculiar.

G06:M039.text: I will put the {Monster File} on the far right shelf. Feel free to read it.
G06:M039.reason: Estante extremo derecho, espacio y permiso.

G06:M040.text: I will look for the other two books as well.

G06:M044.text: Train yourself and strengthen your weapons and armor!
G06:M044.reason: Redacción natural de entrenamiento y mejora.

G06:M047.text: Try using everything and learn from experience!

G06:M048.text: If your Energy runs out, you will start losing HP.
G06:M048.reason: Gramática y condición de pérdida gradual de HP.

G06:M050.text: If you fall in a dungeon, your level drops by one.

G06:M054.text: The Professor has the fourth book.

G06:M060.text: {Camilla's Dad} is a gentle chocobo with few desires, so things did not get too serious.
G06:M060.reason: Restituye consecuencia omitida, evita repetir deseos.

G06:M061.text: But {Atla}... Surely you understand his desires better than anyone?
G06:M061.reason: 君: interlocutor, no Atla; enlace con deseo previo.

G06:M064.text: Those consumed by the Tyrian Crystal create a dungeon as deep as their own desires.
G06:M064.reason: Restituye creación activa y relación con deseos.

G06:M065.text: Many strange items lie within. It drains the souls of adventurers who enter in search of them.
G06:M065.reason: Corrige seeked y presente; restituye drenaje de almas.

G06:M066.text: After absorbing many souls, the Tyrian Crystal grows, splits, and spreads across the world.
G06:M066.reason: Restituye división omitida y secuencia causal.

G06:M067.text: We must seal the Tyrian Crystal before that happens. But how can we seal it?
G06:M067.reason: Restituye prevención y referente, sin desplazar frase anterior.

G06:M068.text: All we could do was defeat the one it had consumed and bury it deep underground.

G06:M072.text: Touch the front of the book to keep your level. Touch the back to start over from level one. I do not understand what this means...
G06:M072.reason: Redacción clara de la pista; conserva perplejidad.

G06:M080.text: Yes, that is right. This one works the same way.
G06:M080.reason: これもそう: confirmación, no entrega Here.

G06:M091.text: The dungeon has appeared for the third time.

G06:M092.text: The Professor and I are investigating a theory.
G06:M092.reason: Trabajo conjunto presente, no idea por consultar.

G06:M096.text: This is the very dungeon they wished for.
G06:M096.reason: Continúa percepción de aldeanos; elimina residuo asbl.

G07:M000.text: The village has grown quite large!
G07:M000.reason: Texto inglés ilegible; restituye crecimiento del pueblo.

G07:M001.text: I wonder how much more it will change.

G07:M002.text: There is still room for more changes.
G07:M002.reason: かわる: cambios del pueblo, no comprensión personal.

G07:M003.text: A few more things will change.

G08:M003.text: He said he would bring lots of items soon and asked me to make room in the storehouse.
G08:M003.reason: Pide espacio libre; no alquiler explícito.

G08:M004.text: Could he have found a dungeon?
G08:M004.reason: Pregunta si encontró una mazmorra; no objetos en ella.

G08:M012.text: Do not push yourself too hard. Take your time.
G08:M012.reason: Inglés natural; consejo de no esforzarse demasiado.

G08:M018.text: I hear {Mill} is going to live with {Chip}.
G08:M018.reason: Restituye futuro y noticia recibida; espacio entre palabras.

G08:M020.text: {Chip} and {Mill} have had babies! Three of them!

G08:M023.text: It seems the scarecrow in the field has been possessed this time.
G08:M023.reason: Posesión clara, no taken in ambiguo.

G08:M024.text: Perhaps these desires did not come from just one heart.

G08:M026.text: I think I understand. That dungeon reflects the hearts of everyone in the village, expressed through the scarecrow.
G08:M026.reason: Corrige dirección de transmisión y relación mazmorra-corazones.

G08:M028.text: Hmm... It feels as if the Tyrian Crystal is deceiving us...
G08:M028.reason: Repara nombre ilegible y perspectiva del hablante.

G10:M002.text: I have been calling for a while, but no one comes out. {Poulet}, help me call them!

G10:M007.reason: レアアイテム: término que la frase siguiente define.

G10:M017.text: It will be fine! Just watch me.

G10:M022.text: You are as slow as ever! I do not know how, but we are in a dungeon. And we found treasure right away!
G10:M022.reason: Restituye sorpresa y secuencia, no causalidad inventada.

G10:M026.text: Ow, ow! What happened this time?

G10:M027.text: Oh, we are in front of the inn. Huh? In front of the inn?!

G10:M030.text: Well, that does not matter right now.

G10:M031.text: The point is, that dungeon could be full of rare items!
G10:M031.reason: Restituye cantidad y posibilidad, término rare items.

G10:M032.text: I will find us a place to stay. {Poulet}, get the gear you need to explore the dungeon. See you later!

G11:M004.text: A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
G11:M004.reason: Fórmula de presentación, no recuerdo previo.

G11:M034.text: He does not think that way?
G11:M034.reason: Repite negación de pensamiento, no mentira.

G11:M035.text: Indeed, he thinks nothing of you at all.
G11:M035.reason: Conserva tercera persona y giro amenazante.

G11:M038.text: Thank you for all your hard work, {Krehl}.

G06:M081.text: Let us call this book the {Item File}.
G06:M081.reason: Repara repetición de línea en ejecución nativa causada por control heredado.
